name: @epoch/adapter-upstash-redis
description: Epoch Upstash Redis adapter (W051, ACR-006) — the EPHEMERAL-ONLY implementation of the W051 RequestGuard port over the Upstash REST API: fixed-window rate-limit counters (1 EVAL command per check: INCR + EXPIRE NX inside one atomic Lua script), epoch-anchored windows via the gateway's canonical fixedWindowKey math (semantically aligned with the in-memory reference), bearer-token REST auth, caller-supplied fetch (injectable for test doubles), timeout + typed failure resolution per the declared failure policy (fail-open default: rate limiting is abuse control, NEVER authorization; fail-closed available). ZERO new dependencies (platform fetch). NEVER authoritative durable state — Redis holds ephemeral counters only (architecture lock, ACR-006).
